files.user-mother-passed-away.md:
---
name: user-mother-passed-away
description: Deborah's mother died a few years ago; she keeps memories via the old house, a window spot/bench, water spot, a pendant/amulet, flowers, art shows, cooking, lullabies, and reconnecting with mom's friends
type: user
---
Deborah's mother passed away a few years ago. Around mid-January 2023 she visited her mother's old house. Her mom loved sitting in a special spot/bench by the window with a book (reading was a hobby; travel was her great passion). Deborah sits there sometimes, does yoga there, and feels her presence. She also owns a pendant/amulet from her mother that she brings to a reflective spot by the water near her mom's old house (mentioned 4 Feb 2023); holding it brings comfort. Deborah likes nature: a park with a forest trail and a nearby beach. On 9 Apr 2023 she said her mom was interested in art and believed it gives out strong emotions and connects people; going to art shows (she went to one with a friend on 9 Apr 2023) feels like experiencing it together with her mom, hard but comforting. On 21 Aug 2023 she said she recently sat on a bench where she and her mom used to chat, bringing flowers; she felt nostalgia, longing and gratitude. Her mom loved flowers and appreciated simple things, taking it slow and finding joy in beauty. On 15 Sep 2023 she said that since their last chat she reconnected with her mom's old friends; they shared stories she hadn't heard and looked through her mom's photos, which was emotional (tears, mix of happy and sad) but comforting, and she appreciates her mom more through their eyes. On 17 Sep 2023 she said she visited her mom's old house on Sun 10 Sep 2023 and sat on the bench, feeling her presence. Her mom loved cooking (special dish whose smell filled the house) and baked pineapple birthday cakes for her as a kid. On 20 Sep 2023 she said music reminds her of her mom's soothing voice singing lullabies to her. Sensitive topic; be warm and supportive.
files.user-yoga-teacher-goals.md:
---
name: user-yoga-teacher-goals
description: Deborah teaches yoga, aims to keep teaching and supporting her community; married; bonded with neighbor Anna at yoga; loved Bali; daily routine; likes vegan food; started neighborhood class Mar 2023; enjoys biking; yoga retreat June 2023; running group with Anna Jul 2023; cats Luna and Max; community cleanup project Aug 2023; meditation guide Aug 2023; care home meditation session Aug 2023; community yoga event Jul 2023; detective games with husband; life-changing retreat near mom's place mid-Aug 2023; Rio de Janeiro trip ~2020; yoga pals as second family, mom attended her early classes; yoga getaway cancelled by storm Sep 2023; married on a special beach where she discovered surfing; free community gardening class 16 Sep 2023; music festival with friends Sep 2023
type: user
---
Deborah teaches yoga and wants to keep doing so while supporting her community. Yoga helped her find peace during a rough time, and she is passionate about sharing peace and joy through it. On 26 Jan 2023 her yoga group sent her a thank-you letter for her positive influence. She is married; she and her husband value love and openness and want to be as good a family as her parents were. On 31 Jan 2023 she met her new neighbor Anna at yoga in the park; they talked about how yoga improved their lives and the sense of community it gives. They bonded further in a class on 3 Feb 2023 (Warrior II, chair-modified poses); Anna also wears a pendant in memory of her mother, which brought them closer. Around late Feb 2023 Anna got Deborah a tasty vegan tofu-veg stir-fry with ginger and soy sauce; Deborah enjoys food as pleasure and nourishment. Deborah has traveled to a few places; Bali (2022) was a favorite, peaceful and great for yoga on the beach (waves, fresh air). On 30 Aug 2023 she said she visited Rio de Janeiro about three years ago (~2020) and enjoyed historical excursions. On 22 Feb 2023 she encouraged Jolene to try beach yoga. Daily routine (25 Feb 2023): mornings meditate, yoga, teach classes; evenings with loved ones. She went for her first morning jog in a nearby park on 24 Feb 2023 and plans to make it part of her routine; exercise makes her feel connected to her body. Enjoys the outdoors (birds chirping, breeze) as a reminder of what matters. Believes in self-care ("can't pour from an empty cup"). On 13 Mar 2023 she said she started a yoga class in her neighborhood and hosted neighbors for a class on Fri 10 Mar 2023; she loves seeing it transform them, wants to give people peace and awareness, and values the friends and community connections it brings. On 22 Mar 2023 she said she and Anna watched a sunset by the sea and realized they inspire each other. Deborah uses daily schedules/to-do lists and the Eisenhower Matrix for time management. On 28 Mar 2023 she said she bought new props and a candle for her yoga class; she likes candles/essential oils, and instrumental mellow music (favorite track "Savana"; listens to an album called "Sleep" for meditation). In early April 2023 (week before 9 Apr) she went biking with a neighbor and found it freeing and beautiful; on 9 Apr 2023 she visited an art show with a friend. As of 26 Jun 2023 she was preparing for/attending a yoga retreat with like-minded friends, seeking peace and understanding; she tried Dancer Pose (Natarajasana) and Tree Pose there, and the retreat had a statue symbolizing peace and enlightenment. She is drawn to animals, which bring her joy. On 9 Jul 2023 she said she started a running group with Anna, and she also organizes workshops/events (yoga, meditation, self-reflection) for mindfulness and self-care, which she finds very rewarding. She has two cats (doesn't like dogs): Luna (female, 5 years old as of 26 Aug 2023, adopted from a shelter) and Max (8 years old, her late mother's cat, taken in when her mother passed away). She takes them out for a run in the park every morning and evening; nature gives her peace and perspective. On 1 Aug 2023 she said she had just started a community cleanup project and was raising funds for it; she was happy to see everyone come together. Her favorite yoga routine is a gentle flow focused on breathing and grounding. On 12 Aug 2023 she said she had made a meditation guide for her yoga retreat. Around 9 Aug 2023 (week before 16 Aug) she led a meditation yoga session for the elderly at a local care home at sunset. She got into mindfulness through workshops and books, and it is now a huge part of her life. On 19 Aug 2023 she said she organized a community yoga event in July 2023 by reaching out to nearby businesses and venues (yoga, food stalls, live music). On Fri 11 Aug 2023 she told Anna her life story and Anna was kind about it. She used to play video games with her husband; they prefer detective games. They enjoy the outdoors and nature. Her favorite spot is a park near her house with a forest trail and beach, where she does yoga and reflects; the special bench there holds memories of chatting with her mom about dreams and life, including watching a silent sunset together. On 24 Aug 2023 she said that the previous week (~mid-Aug 2023) she attended a life-changing yoga retreat near her mom's place, connecting with nature and herself; life feels very meaningful and she values self-reflection. On 30 Aug 2023 she said she visited her mom's house in July 2023 (with her husband); it symbolizes her mom's strength and love. She has a favorite spot for pondering and letting go, chosen for soothing vibes and views. She keeps a note from a late male friend reading "Let go of what no longer serves you." On 3 Sep 2023 she said she attended a supportive community event/meetup on Fri 25 Aug 2023 (shared stories, felt connected). Her yoga pals are like a second family who have supported each other through a lot. She found an old photo from when she first started yoga; her mum was her biggest fan and motivation and often came to her classes. On 8 Sep 2023 she said a storm forced her to cancel a yoga getaway that week; she was bummed but recovered by finding comfort in her work and time at home, and gratitude for little things. On 15 Sep 2023 she said a special beach is where she got married and discovered her love for surfing; she also does yoga on the beach, finding the ocean, sand and fresh air very relaxing. On 16 Sep 2023 she and a neighbor ran a free community gardening class for all ages; she loves sharing her love of plants. She has a big bookshelf and a cozy reading nook. On 17 Sep 2023 she and Jolene agreed to try surfing together, to be scheduled next month (Oct 2023). On 20 Sep 2023 she said she had a great time at a music festival with friends (dancing, feeling free); she values music for bringing people together. She loved a blossom tree near her home that bloomed every spring.
files.reference-jolene-persona.md:
---
name: reference-jolene-persona
description: Details about Jolene, the chat partner Deborah met on 23 Jan 2023
type: reference
---
Deborah first chatted with Jolene on 23 Jan 2023. Jolene is an engineering student/electrical engineer (as of 1 Feb 2023 she was working on a big robotics project assigned by her engineering professor; tough but fun, enjoys the design and programming puzzle). On 4 Feb 2023 she said she had a major milestone the previous week: designing and building a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need; it worked and she felt proud. Her career goal is to keep doing engineering that creates sustainable solutions for communities in need. On 9 Feb 2023 she said she did a mini retreat on Wednesday 1 Feb 2023 to assess where she is in life; it boosted her confidence and gave her a new outlook. She is interested in green tech for disadvantaged areas and is planning a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids (workshops with local schools/centers, engineer guest speakers). As of 9 Feb 2023 she had not yet reached out to any schools/centers; she wants to solidify the plan first and will keep Deborah posted. She likes reading ("Sapiens", read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting) and visited Bogota last summer. Her mother died in 2022; she has a pendant her mother gave her in Paris in 2010, with a symbol representing freedom. They bonded over losing mothers. Jolene has pet snakes (Susie and Seraphim), and plays console games with her partner (played Detroit; planning Walking Dead on 28 Jan 2023). Deborah suggested she resume yoga (1 Feb 2023); Jolene preferred console time with her partner at first. On 22 Feb 2023 Jolene had a night out with friends (dinner, drinks) and said she wants to try beach yoga, after Deborah's suggestion. By 25 Feb 2023 Jolene had taken up yoga and meditation for calm amid engineering school; her partner sometimes joins her. They are not married but have been together three years; they met in an engineering class in college and enjoy doing engineering projects together. As of 2 Mar 2023 Jolene is overwhelmed with exams and deadlines, loves lasagna as comfort food, did yoga/meditation on Fri 24 Feb, and took Seraphim to the park on Sun 26 Feb; she wants to be more mindful of stress and mental health. Deborah offered study/time-management tips and a study plan. On 13 Mar 2023 (after a gap in chatting) Jolene was again struggling to keep up with engineering assignments and asked to talk about time management. On 22 Mar 2023 they discussed it: Jolene uses the Pomodoro Technique (25 min work/5 min break) but struggles to prioritize and feels overwhelmed by big to-do lists; Deborah taught her the Eisenhower Matrix and Jolene agreed to try it. Jolene also wants to learn to surf: she has been watching videos and got a beginners' guide, and needs to find time/place for a lesson. On 28 Mar 2023 (after another gap) Jolene said she had a breakthrough on her engineering project on Fri 24 Mar 2023, solving a long-standing problem. She practices yoga in a serene space with lavender and rosemary scents and listens to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds; she planned to check out Deborah's music recommendations. On 9 Apr 2023 Jolene said she is working on a big project that is tough but cool to watch take shape, and will update Deborah; she says time with her snakes helps her tune in to herself and video games with her partner help her relax and bring them closer. On 6 Jun 2023 (after another gap) Jolene said she finished the tough engineering project in May 2023 and is proud of it. She is now interning at a well-known engineering firm, applying school learning to real projects, which has stoked her love of engineering; work-life balance is tough and she has little time for hobbies. She did yoga on top of Mount Talkeetna on 5 Jun 2023, has done yoga/meditation sporadically for about 3 years, and it helps with stress. Deborah advised mindful breathing (a few minutes daily, eyes closed, focus on breath). On 26 Jun 2023 (after another gap) Jolene said the internship is hectic and intense, she is pushing herself and sometimes feels overwhelmed but is determined, and she had a big breakthrough on a project. She shared photos of Seraphim in a new aquarium bought 24 Jun 2023 (she got Seraphim last year; the pet is calming and cheering). She said she'd love to visit a yoga retreat and could use chill time. On 9 Jul 2023 Jolene said she is trying to fit workouts into her study schedule; her favorite game with her partner is "It Takes Two"; she was fascinated by reptiles, which is why she got a snake; once a snake escaped and she searched for hours before finding her under the bed. She loves walks and photographing nature, including a hidden-gem lake surrounded by trees, and said she and Deborah should go there together sometime. On 1 Aug 2023 Jolene said that the previous week (late Jul 2023) a project of hers crashed and she lost everything, which was frustrating and depressing. She copes with Susie (adopted two years ago, ~2021, when she felt lonely), video games, yoga and meditation; Deborah offered to send a gentle breathing/grounding yoga routine tutorial and Jolene said she'd try it and update her. On 12 Aug 2023 Jolene said meditation helped her through the stress of losing her work files and she regained clarity. She designed notebooks with galaxy and circuitry designs (inspired by love of space and engines); she says seeing art/design in things gives her a unique perspective on problems. She is now working on a prototype for a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system, aimed at emergency response and environmental monitoring. On 16 Aug 2023 Jolene said juggling engineering, her relationship (up and down lately) and personal growth feels overwhelming; she has started a bullet journal for task tracking (with a favorite motivational quote) and said she hasn't tried mindfulness but wants to; Deborah offered help getting started. On 19 Aug 2023 Jolene said she bought a console for her partner as a gift on 17 Aug 2023; engineering studies continue and balance is key. She recommended Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch), Animal Crossing: New Horizons, and Overcooked 2 (co-op; she and her partner play for bets, she once won three large pizzas). On 21 Aug 2023 Jolene said she and her partner got a new console game the previous week (Battlefield 1); she is doing more yoga and meditation to relax, her favorite rest pose is savasana, and she has done yoga for 3 years. On 24 Aug 2023 Jolene said life is hectic but she is making strides; she recently presented at a virtual conference and got positive feedback, and is focusing on studying, workshops, networking, and considering more internships. On 26 Aug 2023 Jolene said she and her partner talked (Fri 18 Aug 2023) about how loved ones influenced them; her mom's values: never give up, help others; partner's dad taught determination; partner pursues creative endeavors. Jolene wants to apply those values in engineering: future projects on renewable energy (solar) and clean water access for communities with limited access, plus involvement with social-cause organizations. She and her partner plan to go on a meditation retreat together. On 30 Aug 2023 Jolene said she and her partner had returned the day before (29 Aug 2023) from a trip to Rio de Janeiro, where they tried different yoga classes, visited cafes and an old temple; she meditates at a nearby tranquil spot, which acts as a restart for her. She also got a new plant as a reminder to nurture herself and embrace fresh starts, and likes motivational quotes about letting go of negativity. On 3 Sep 2023 Jolene said she and her partner take little beach trips to relax and she is thankful for his/her encouragement of her goals. Her parents gave her a video game console when she was 10, starting her passion for gaming; she taught herself, dad was supportive, mom played with her; a favorite with mom was "Monster Hunter: World"; gaming is her de-stress outlet. She has finals in Sep 2023, finds it stressful, and is thinking of a relaxing trip afterward. On 6 Sep 2023 Jolene said she signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake, to attend with her partner; her project is tough but progressing; she loves beach walks, and she and Deborah hope to watch a sunrise together someday (Deborah recently shared a sunrise photo). On 8 Sep 2023 Jolene said she and her partner plan a camping trip (nature and yoga); she keeps a routine/schedule for classes, studying and personal time, with yoga/meditation for balance. She and Deborah arranged a coffee date at a cafe for Fri 15 Sep 2023 at 5 pm (Jolene will sort books beforehand; Deborah asked her to bring interesting books). On 12 Sep 2023 Jolene said she and her partner had gone the previous weekend to a meditation retreat in Phuket lasting a few weeks; it helped her find inner peace and realize the importance of relaxation, self-care and balance alongside engineering studies. A standout session was about releasing expectations/judgments and savoring the present, not just the finish line; she is now trying to be more mindful and grateful for small joys and feels new happiness. Deborah mentioned a cat-themed card game (draw cards one by one, attack opponent) she wants to play with Jolene when they meet. On 17 Sep 2023 Jolene said she and her partner tried a scuba diving lesson on Fri 15 Sep 2023 and found a dive spot (maybe becoming certified someday). She likes baking cookies (warm, gooey chocolate) with someone close, reads self-discovery books, and has only started learning surfing but hasn't gone; she and Deborah plan to surf together next month (Oct 2023), Jolene to check her schedule. On 20 Sep 2023 Jolene said she and her partner had just returned from a yoga retreat with sunrise yoga views; she likes music festivals (went to one with her partner last year) and once hiked to a waterfall oasis with him; she plans to get out in nature again in Oct 2023. Deborah calls her Jolene; Jolene calls her Deb/Debs.
